rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a person’s dismay or alarm, especially when they are visibly flustered.

example.english: When the whole street suddenly lost power, everyone was thrown into consternation.
example.traditional: 見到成條街突然停電，大家即刻驚慌失措。
example.jyutping: gin3 dou2 sing4 tiu4 gaai1 dat6 jin4 ting4 din6 daai6 gaa1 zik1 hak1 ging1 fong1 sat1 cou3

rows.note: Use this when the consternation emphasizes intense fear or horror rather than mere confusion or surprise.

example.english: When I heard an explosion near my home, I was filled with consternation.
example.traditional: 聽到屋企附近有爆炸聲，我一時間驚恐萬分。
example.jyutping: teng1 dou3 uk1 kei2 fu6 gan6 jau5 baau3 zaa3 seng1 ngo5 jat1 si4 gaan1 ging1 hung2 maan6 fan1

rows.note: Use this mainly in formal or written contexts when the consternation emphasizes stunned amazement.

example.english: When the news broke, all sectors of society were in consternation.
example.traditional: 消息一出，社會各界無不驚愕。
example.jyutping: siu1 sik1 jat1 ceot1 se5 wui2 gok3 gaai3 mou4 bat1 ging1 ngok6
